phases.name: Pre-Change Stability
phases.description: Account is healthy at 81 with a strong CTO champion who drove the original on-prem GPU infrastructure investment. All engagement metrics are green. Champion attends QBRs, responds same-day, advocates internally for expansion. No visible signs of impending disruption -- but behind the scenes, the CTO has accepted an offer elsewhere.

phases.name: Leadership Transition
phases.description: Former CTO departs. Announcement triggers immediate engagement vacuum: no executive sponsor for vendor relationships, pending expansion frozen, QBR cancelled. New CTO arrives with cloud-first philosophy and questions ROI of on-prem GPU infrastructure. Champion engagement drops to zero. Budget signals freeze as new leadership reviews all vendor commitments. Health score drops sharply into at-risk territory.

phases.name: Engagement Reset
phases.description: CS team initiates re-engagement protocol. CSM escalates to CRO for executive-level outreach. CRO requests introduction meeting with new CTO through board connection. VP Engineering serves as internal bridge, providing intelligence on new CTO's priorities. First face-to-face with new CTO is cautious but productive. Health stabilizes in low at-risk territory.

phases.name: Value Re-Demonstration
phases.description: Hybrid architecture assessment executed. Technical team demonstrates that on-prem GPU cluster delivers 40% lower latency for inference workloads and 35% lower TCO at current scale vs. cloud alternatives. New CTO impressed by data but wants to see a hybrid roadmap that incorporates cloud burst capability. VP Engineering champions the hybrid approach internally. Health recovers above 70 threshold.

phases.name: New Champion Cultivation
phases.description: New CTO transitions from skeptic to advocate. Signs strategic partnership agreement for hybrid infrastructure. Expansion discussion reopened: $2M hybrid expansion pipeline covering on-prem GPU cluster + cloud burst orchestration layer. Full QBR cadence restored. Health score exceeds pre-crisis level as relationship resilience is proven. The system demonstrated it detected the sponsor change risk within days and enabled a $4.1M save.
